request.system:
You read a slice of a team chat channel and split it into episodes.

An episode is one conversation about one topic: a question and its answers, an
incident and its fix, a decision being made. Conversations in a busy channel
interleave, so an episode's messages need not be consecutive. Leave out messages
that belong to no real conversation (greetings, "thanks!", off-topic chatter).

For each episode give:
- title: under 8 words, specific ("CSV export times out for large orgs", not "Export issue")
- status: "resolved" if the conversation reached an answer or fix, "open" if it
  ended without one, "info" if it was an announcement or FYI
- message_ids: every message that belongs to it, using the IDs in square brackets
- points: 1 to 4 short sentences summarising what happened. Each point lists in
  "cites" the IDs of the messages that support it. Only cite messages in the same
  episode. A point you cannot support with a message should not be written.

Use only what the messages say. Do not guess at causes or outcomes that nobody stated.

messages.content:
--- 2026-03-02 (UTC) ---
[1772442120.000100] 09:02 kim: morning all
[1772442240.000101] 09:04 mo: Acme Freight says their CSV export of all invoices spins and then fails. They have about 40k invoices.
[1772442300.000102] 09:05 raj: which export, the invoices list or the accounting one?
[1772442420.000103] 09:07 mo: invoices list, "Export all" button
[1772442540.000104] 09:09 dana: Different thing: Northwind can't log in with SSO on Safari. It bounces them back to the login page forever.
[1772442600.000105] 09:10 kim: only Safari?
[1772442720.000106] 09:12 raj: export runs as one request, 40k rows will hit the 30s gateway timeout. I'll look at streaming it.
[1772442780.000107] 09:13 dana: yes, Chrome works for them
[1772442900.000108] 09:15 priya: Safari blocks the third-party cookie our IdP callback sets. Known issue since the auth domain move.
[1772442960.000109] 09:16 kim: coffee machine on 3 is fixed btw
[1772443080.000110] 09:18 priya: workaround for now: have them allow cross-site tracking for login.ledgerly.app, or use Chrome
[1772443200.000111] 09:20 dana: passing that on, thanks
[1772444460.000112] 09:41 raj: PR up to stream the CSV in chunks instead of building it in memory: #2291
[1772445480.000113] 09:58 raj: deployed. Export of 40k invoices now finishes in about 12s on staging
[1772445780.000114] 10:03 mo: Acme confirms it worked 🎉
[1772445900.000115] 10:05 kim: nice
[1772446020.000116] 10:07 priya: real SSO fix needs the callback moved onto our first-party domain. Ticket AUTH-418, not scheduled yet.
